article.headline: San Antonio hosts Minnesota after overtime win against Utah
article.description: Minnesota Timberwolves (4-2, seventh in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (3-2, eighth in the Western Conference)
article.title: San Antonio hosts Minnesota after overtime win against Utah
article.linkText: San Antonio hosts Minnesota after overtime win against Utah
article.story: Minnesota Timberwolves (4-2, seventh in the Western Conference) vs. San Antonio Spurs (3-2, eighth in the Western Conference) San Antonio; Saturday, 8 p.m. EDT LINE: Spurs -11.5; over/under is 226.5 BOTTOM LINE: San Antonio hosts the Minnesota Timberwolves following the San Antonio Spurs' 117-111 overtime victory over the Utah Jazz. San Antonio finished 62-20 overall, 36-16 in Western Conference play and 32-8 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Spurs shot 48.3% from the field and 35.9% from 3-point range last season. Minnesota finished 49-33 overall and 31-21 in Western Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Timberwolves averaged 18.3 points off of turnovers, 14.3 second-chance points and 35.0 bench points last season. INJURIES: Spurs: Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: day to day (calf). Timberwolves: Donte DiVincenzo: out (achilles), Anthony Edwards: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
